QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Pass the Barrier
QuestInfo.0: Go tell #bPerzen#k in #bAltaire Camp#k that the airship repair is almost complete.
QuestInfo.1:
Perzen is surprised that you crossed the barrier. He said he's going to show you to #bAthena Pierce#k, the Chief Explorer.
Talk to #bAthena Pierce#k in the #bCamp Conference Room#k.
QuestInfo.2: Athena Pierce believed you're from the future and asked that you keep this fact a secret to prevent confusing the people here.
